entries.finding: Experimental degree-2 univariate RC response is centre-value exact while pole derivatives differ. Hysteresis mixed-term truncation is not the RC mechanism.
entries.scope: Public 600-record diagnostic, not H7 campaign performance
entries.adaptation: Require derivative and joint-query checks in any basis intervention; do not add cross-pole response terms without a physical need.

entries.finding: With unknown nuisance parameters, projection onto residualized target columns determines conditional bias; response-value equality can coexist with incorrect fit updates or precision.
entries.adaptation: Extend H3 two-column charge diagnostic to nuisance-aware joint sensitivity and weak-direction normalization.

entries.finding: Contracting physical state and accumulating log-likelihood error obey different bounds; neither monotonic aging nor repeated stimuli establishes indefinite compression accuracy.
entries.adaptation: Keep state transport and evidence error budgets separate; select evolution/state convention before aging compression.

entries.finding: Paired decay/complement preserves fixed equilibrium; independent coefficient errors can cause systematic bias despite stable recurrence.
entries.adaptation: Test equilibrium/transient and query-normalized defects before selecting quantizers or exact coefficient caches.

entries.finding: Fresh observation values prevent exact repeated-objective scaling, and design defects can change realized displacement.
